line: Your about page describes the online Yoga and Meditation portal you launched as "the Middle East's most complete website for Yoga & Meditation."
notes: Took rank 2 (About page) over rank 1 (framework/service blurb) because rank 1 is generic personal-branding hero copy that could describe any coach's site ('The rise of digital content has made it possible to be seen 24 hours a day...'), which fails ban #1. The About page's detail about conceptualizing and launching yoginfinity.com is a specific founding-story fact unique to her, not transferable copy.
